description: Maps the eight primary agents, plus the independent code-reviewer, to SDD phases. Data only: agent manifests are unchanged. Agents absent from this map cannot own SDD tasks.

agents.rationale: Read-only repository analysis grounds the constitution, answers factual open questions and checks consistency.
Advisor that structures requirements, decisions, task breakdown and cross-artifact analysis.
Sharpens requirement and acceptance-criterion wording so they are unambiguous and testable.
Supplies verified observations of an existing site as requirement input and resolves factual questions.
Implements and reconciles frontend tasks inside the declared scope.
Implements and reconciles backend tasks inside the declared scope.
Implements and reconciles Kotlin Multiplatform tasks inside the declared scope.
Reviews testability of requirements and authors end-to-end tests as tasks; as an implementer it is not an independent validator.
Strictly read-only reviewer independent of every implementer; the only agent eligible for the final gate.
